question: With frozen market alarms, can ex-ante lag and historical recovery rank not-yet-deep coins by subsequent deep decline and recovery?
alarm_policy: Reuse saved exact alarm timestamps, thresholds,15m cooldown and1s latency; no new alarm fitting or event-based selection. Every alarm in the available coverage is retained; August22 is separate.
availability: 5m coin OHLCV becomes known at its close+1second. Reference price and features use the latest such completed5m bar. Market beta features are synchronized to the same5m close, never comparing a fresh major price to stale altcoin quotes.

eligibility.definition: Known30m close return >-2percent AND minimum completed30m low / close30mago >0.95. All feature rows require complete8day history,positive last3bar volume,finite historical scores. Already-deep and unavailable cases remain counted separately. No future information filters candidates.

features.lag: (coin log return30m - trailing7day beta * synchronous median-major log return30m) / (prior24h coin sigma5m *sqrt6). Beta and sigma exclude the latest completed return.
features.recovery: Mean clipped (close-low)/(previous_close-low) of prior7days5m bars whose low drops by at least2 prior24h sigmas from previous close; at least5 such bars. This is historical within-bar recovery, not future target recovery.
features.liquidity_proxy: Prior24h sum(close*base_volume); approximate traded dollar volume, not order-book depth.

selection.lag: Within each alarm, highest lag score ceil(10percent*N), deterministic symbol ties.
selection.lag_then_recovery: Same count: take highest2K lag candidates, then highest historical recovery K. Relative to lag-only, only second-stage ordering changes; no parameter search.
selection.matching: Same alarm x causal volume tertile x causal volatility tertile. Match each selected-cell count to nonselected candidates without replacement. Insufficient cells are unmatched, never broadened. Exact expected random-candidate label rate within each matched cell is the control; all selected results also retained.

outcomes.definition: Deep means first new crossing of reference*0.95 within15m after alarm. Joint recovery means a later completed close >=reference*0.975 by60m after alarm. These are observational labels, not limit fills, exits or PnL.
outcomes.bounds: Lower: no possible deep touch in the bar straddling alarm, a definite crossing in a full bar contained in the15m window, and for joint label a later completed close after that crossing bar. Upper: any crossing in a bar intersecting15m window and possible later recovery by60m. Crossing/recovery inside a boundary bar is ambiguous. Missing outcome data gives lower0/upper1,never silently removes an eligible candidate.
outcomes.minute_cache: Touch-day-selected1m caches cannot define the universe, features, eligibility, ranking or primary point estimates. Existing FHE tick data may annotate the original single example only.

statistics.primary: Prospective deep-and-recovery joint frequency per selected candidate and per alarm, with interval bounds. Report decline frequency and conditional recovery separately. Week-block paired confidence intervals; same alarm controls. No coin-iid tests.
statistics.uncertainty: Robust excess bounds selected_lower-control_upper and selected_upper-control_lower. Test lower-bound weekly excess via sign randomization,then Holm over2rules x2outcomes for pooled six alarms. All scores and quantile choices fixed before outcomes;2025and2026reported separately.
statistics.na_metrics: No training,trade return or execution: valAUC,winrate,fees,topdecile netR are inapplicable. Use target-frequency bounds and matched randomized candidate controls instead.
